_note: Geometry for the schematic map of the project. Tunnel routes are drawn smoothly from point to point: no alignment has been studied. Corridor lengths are planning estimates read from maps. The Seine and the existing lines are sketched by hand for orientation.

stations.name: Paris Nord-Est
stations.where: Under and between Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est, which are 500 m apart.
stations.calls: Every train of the project stops here: from the north, the east, the southeast and the Atlantic.
stations.surface: Both halls become entrances. The surface platforms and the approach tracks of both stations are no longer needed.
stations.under: under Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est

stations.name: Gare de Lyon
stations.calls: Trains of the southeast: high-speed trains to Lyon and Marseille, suburban line R, regional express.
stations.surface: The hall is kept as the entrance. The surface tracks towards Bercy are no longer needed.

stations.name: Montparnasse
stations.calls: Trains of the Atlantic: high-speed trains to Bordeaux, Rennes and Nantes, suburban line N, regional express.
stations.surface: The hall is kept as the entrance. The surface tracks towards the ring road are no longer needed.

junctions.name: Northern junction
junctions.what: Where the corridors from the north and from the east meet, just before the station.

junctions.name: Southern junction
junctions.what: Where the tunnels to Gare de Lyon and to Montparnasse part, just after the station.
